integrity: The coefficients are derived directly from the exact standardized inverse-Gaussian density by a uniform analytic Taylor expansion. Exact polynomial identities certify the two integrated coefficients; numerical quadrature is used only as a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is asymptotic for fixed standardized radius as the dimensionless inverse-Gaussian concentration parameter tends to infinity. It does not classify all finite-shape crossings or assert global monotonicity in the shape parameter.
title: A square-root-five phase boundary in inverse-Gaussian central-mass Gaussianization
